result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. Nothing is committed.

- **HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `.htm|.html|.xhtml`. The old `html|html|xhtml` had a duplicate `html` and no `htm`.
- **JS and XML:** the "Generated by" JS rule is now `.*[.]js` (was `.*/[.]js`), and the .NET `<doc>` XML rule is now `.*[.]xml` (was `.*/[.]xml`). The content patterns still limit them to generated files.
- **Gradle:** the build-and-deployment rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` (was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`), so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I changed six lines. `mvn -o` compiled the module, and `SourceFileFilterTest` and `CodeConfigurationTest` pass. There is no existing test for these default conventions, and I did not add one. I also could not run a scratch check of the new regexes against sample names, because writing to `/tmp` was denied.
